# GulfCalc (gulfcalc.tech): Complete Enterprise LLM Context & Knowledge Base
> An unmetered, high-precision, client-side statutory calculation and financial intelligence platform for the 6 Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member nations: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, State of Kuwait, State of Qatar, Sultanate of Oman, and Kingdom of Bahrain.

Domain: https://gulfcalc.tech
Repository: https://github.com/Sheharyar-ans/gulfcalc
Operating Architecture: Client-Side WebAssembly/Vanilla JavaScript with Semantic HTML5, Zero PII Logging, Pure Mathematical Determination.
Editorial Tone: Institutional, mathematically rigorous, devoid of marketing hyperbole and AI conversational filler.

================================================================================
1. PLATFORM ARCHITECTURAL OVERVIEW & ZERO-PII GUARANTEE
================================================================================
GulfCalc is engineered specifically for corporate CFOs, human resource directors, expatriate professionals, legal counsel, and cross-border payroll administrators operating in the Gulf Cooperation Council. 

Unlike conventional financial calculators that transmit salary and compensation data to backend servers for tracking or advertising profiling, GulfCalc executes 100% of arithmetic evaluations within the client's local web browser runtime. 
- Zero cookies for user profiling
- Zero server-side database storage of compensation numbers
- No external third-party tracker scripts or outbound tracking beacons
- Verified mathematical alignment with respective GCC labor ministries and official gazettes

2. CENTRAL GATEWAYS
================================================================================

2.1 Homepage Portal
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/index.html
- Purpose: Unified access point featuring real-time client-side search filtering across 12 statutory utilities, reactive side-by-side accrual comparison between UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and Qatar, dynamic country filter tabs with SVG flag iconography, and GCC regulatory comparison matrices.

2.2 Central GCC Labour Laws Directory
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/labour-laws/index.html
- Purpose: Comprehensive comparative directory of private sector employment codes across all 6 GCC member states. Includes detailed side-by-side matrices comparing statutory daily wage divisors, resignation penalties, probationary ceilings, minimum wage mandates, and direct calculation gateways.

2.3 GCC Legal & Financial Intelligence Blog Hub
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/index.html
- Purpose: Searchable repository of 10 in-depth legal, tax, and employment intelligence articles addressing high-intent regulatory topics, statutory revisions, and corporate tax compliance across the Arabian Gulf.

3. 12 DEDICATED GCC FINANCIAL & STATUTORY CALCULATORS
================================================================================

3.1 Kuwait Indemnity Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-indemnity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Kuwait Private Sector Labour Law No. 6 of 2010 (Articles 51, 53 & 55).
- Statutory Daily Wage Divisor: Exactly 26 working days (Daily Wage = Monthly Remuneration / 26).
- Accrual Scale: 15 working days per year for years 1 through 5; 30 working days per year for year 6 onwards.
- Maximum Statutory Cap: 1.5 years remuneration (18 months of monthly salary).
- Resignation Deductions (Article 53):
  * Less than 3 years: 0% entitlement
  * 3 to 5 years: 50% entitlement
  * 5 to 10 years: 66.67% (two-thirds) entitlement
  * 10+ years: 100% entitlement

3.2 Saudi End of Service Award (EOSA) Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-end-of-service-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Saudi Labour Law (Royal Decree No. M/51), Articles 84, 85, 86, and 87.
- Wage Calculation Basis: Actual Wage (Basic Salary + Fixed Housing Allowance + Fixed Transportation Allowance).
- Accrual Scale: 15 days (half month) per year for first 5 years; 30 days (full month) per year thereafter.
- Resignation Deductions (Article 85):
  * Less than 2 years: 0% entitlement
  * 2 to 5 years: 33.33% (one-third) entitlement
  * 5 to 10 years: 66.67% (two-thirds) entitlement
  * 10+ years: 100% entitlement
- Article 87 Statutory Exceptions (100% award regardless of tenure):
  * Female worker resigning within 6 months of marriage or 3 months of childbirth
  * Worker leaving due to force majeure
  * Termination resulting from employer breach under Article 81

3.3 UAE End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (Article 51).
- Wage Calculation Basis: Last drawn Monthly Basic Wage (excludes allowances and commissions).
- Accrual Scale: 21 calendar days per year for years 1 through 5; 30 calendar days per year for year 6 onwards.
- Maximum Statutory Cap: 2 years basic salary (24 months of basic wage).
- Resignation Parity: Post-2021 labor law harmonized resignation and employer termination into identical entitlements once 1 continuous year is reached.

3.4 Qatar End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/qatar-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Qatar Labour Law No. 14 of 2004 (Article 54) & Ministry of Labour Guidelines.
- Wage Calculation Basis: Last drawn Monthly Basic Wage.
- Accrual Scale: Minimum 21 calendar days (3 weeks) per completed year of continuous service.
- Fractional Tenure: Exact pro-rata calculation for partial months and days.
- Resignation: Fully payable upon completion of 1 continuous year of service.

3.5 Oman End of Service Gratuity Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/oman-gratuity-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Oman Labour Law under Royal Decree No. 53/2023 (Article 61).
- Accrual Standard: Flat 30 days (1 full month basic wage) for every completed year of service starting from year one.
- Legacy Scale Engine: Seamlessly calculates pre-July 2023 service under RD 35/2003 (15 days for first 3 years, 30 days thereafter) and post-July 2023 service under RD 53/2023.

3.6 Bahrain End of Service Indemnity (EOSI) & VAT Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/bahrain-eosi-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Bahrain Labour Law for Private Sector (Law No. 36 of 2012, Article 116).
- Accrual Scale: 15 days wage per year for years 1 through 3; 30 days (one month) per year for year 4 onwards.
- SIO Expat Reform: Reflects 2024 Social Insurance Organisation deposit framework under Decision No. 109/2023.
- Integrated VAT Module: 10% standard Bahrain VAT calculation and reverse extraction engine.

3.7 UAE Corporate Tax Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-corporate-tax-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses.
- Statutory Rates: 0% on net taxable profits up to AED 375,000; 9% on net taxable profits exceeding AED 375,000.
- Small Business Relief (SBR): Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023 relief election for resident taxable businesses with gross annual turnover up to AED 3,000,000.

3.8 GCC Remittance True Cost Engine
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-remittance-fee-calculator.html
- Core Mechanics: Identifies hidden exchange rate spreads charged by commercial banks and money transfer operators.
- Corridors: Origin currencies (AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD) to recipient currencies (INR, PKR, PHP, BDT, EGP).
- Mathematical Formula: Total Financial Friction = Upfront Fee + (Transfer Amount * Exchange Rate Spread %).

3.9 Saudi Social Insurance (GOSI) & SANED Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-gosi-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Saudi Social Insurance Law (Royal Decree No. M/22) and SANED Unemployment Insurance (Royal Decree No. M/18).
- Citizen Contributions: 9.75% Annuity Branch + 0.75% SANED (Employee: 10.5%; Employer: 10.5% total 21.0%).
- Expatriate Non-Saudi Contributions: Flat 2.0% Occupational Hazards branch paid 100% by employer (0% deduction from expat salary).
- Statutory Contributory Ceiling: 45,000 SAR monthly wage cap.

3.10 GCC Inter-City Cost of Living & Expat Parity Comparator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-cost-of-living-comparator.html
- Purpose: Mathematical purchasing power, compensation parity, rent, schooling, and consumption tax comparator between GCC commercial capitals.
- Metropolises Indexed: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah, Doha, Kuwait City, Muscat, Manama.
- Key Indexes: Composite living cost index, weighted residential rent, international British/IB curriculum tuition, utility tariffs, and local VAT rates.

3.11 Kuwait PIFSS Social Security & Net Salary Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-pifss-net-salary-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: Kuwait Social Security Law (Amiri Decree No. 61 of 1976) administered by PIFSS.
- Citizen Employee Deduction: 10.5% monthly basic salary (7.5% Basic System + 2.5% Supplementary System + 0.5% Unemployment).
- Expatriate Deduction: 0.0% (Expatriates are not covered by PIFSS; 100% of agreed contractual remuneration is received net).
- Statutory Ceiling: 3,000 KWD monthly maximum contributory wage for Kuwaiti nationals.

3.12 UAE Real Estate Investor 10-Year Golden Visa Calculator
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-golden-visa-property-calculator.html
- Primary Statute: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022 regarding Golden Visa Executive Regulations.
- Minimum Investment Threshold: AED 2,000,000 property value (single asset or consolidated portfolio).
- Transaction Cost Engine: Mandatory 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) transfer fee, AED 4,200 trustee registration fees, and agency commissions.
- Financing & Equity: Evaluates 20% down payment mortgage rules, debt service coverage, and projected net rental yields after service charges.

================================================================================
4. 10 PEER-REVIEWED GCC LEGAL & TAX ANALYTICAL ARTICLES
================================================================================

4.1 UAE Gratuity Calculation Under Limited Contracts in 2026
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-gratuity-calculation-limited-contract-2026.html
- Legal Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021
- Summary: Analysis of the legal unification of fixed-term employment contracts across the UAE private sector, detailing the absolute abolition of historical resignation penalties and unexpired contract penalties.

4.2 Saudi Labour Law Articles 84 & 85: Resignation Rules & Actual Wage
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/saudi-labor-law-article-84-85-resignation-rules.html
- Legal Statute: Saudi Labour Law (Royal Decree No. M/51)
- Summary: Detailed statutory examination of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD) definition of 'actual wage' (basic plus fixed housing and transport allowances), tiered resignation penalties, and Article 87 statutory exceptions.

4.3 Kuwait Labour Law Article 55: The 26 Working Days Rule
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/kuwait-labor-law-article-55-26-days-calculation.html
- Legal Statute: Kuwait Private Sector Labour Law No. 6 of 2010
- Summary: Mathematical analysis and legal justification for using the mandatory 26-day divisor instead of 30 days when calculating daily wages for terminal indemnity in Kuwait, backed by Public Authority for Manpower (PAM) enforcement rulings.

4.4 Oman Labour Law Royal Decree 53/2023: The 30-Day Gratuity Standard
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/oman-new-labor-law-royal-decree-53-2023-gratuity.html
- Legal Statute: Oman Royal Decree No. 53/2023
- Summary: Deconstruction of Oman's major labor reform under His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik, highlighting the shift from the old two-tiered severance formula to a uniform 30-day salary per year of service starting from year one.

4.5 UAE Corporate Tax: Small Business Relief (SBR) Compliance Guide
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-corporate-tax-small-business-relief-guide.html
- Legal Statute: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 & Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023
- Summary: Practical compliance roadmap for UAE resident enterprises with gross annual revenue under AED 3,000,000 electing Small Business Relief, covering registration, record-keeping, and transfer pricing obligations.

4.6 Qatar End of Service Benefits & Statutory Overtime Under Law No. 14/2004
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/qatar-end-of-service-benefits-overtime-wages.html
- Legal Statute: Qatar Labour Law No. 14 of 2004
- Summary: Deconstruction of Qatar's 21-day annual severance accrual, fractional tenure mathematics, and statutory overtime compensation rates (125% regular overtime, 150% night/weekend overtime).

4.7 Bahrain SIO Expatriate End of Service Reform: Direct Deposit Framework
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/bahrain-sio-expat-end-of-service-reform.html
- Legal Statute: Bahrain Labour Law No. 36 of 2012 & Ministerial Decision No. 109 of 2023
- Summary: Comprehensive operational analysis of Bahrain's transition from company balance-sheet reserves to mandatory monthly employer deposits into the Social Insurance Organisation (SIO) fund for non-Bahraini personnel.

4.8 GCC VAT Reverse Charge Mechanism: Cross-Border SaaS & Services
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/gcc-vat-reverse-charge-mechanism-cross-border-services.html
- Legal Statute: GCC Unified VAT Agreement & National Implementing Regulations
- Summary: Technical accounting walkthrough for GCC companies purchasing foreign cloud hosting, SaaS subscriptions, and digital marketing services, detailing self-assessment entries on VAT return boxes.

4.9 Dubai Golden Visa 2026: Real Estate & Salary Thresholds Compared
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/dubai-golden-visa-real-estate-salary-thresholds.html
- Legal Statute: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022
- Summary: Cost-benefit and regulatory comparison between the AED 2,000,000 property investment track and the AED 30,000 monthly executive employment track for obtaining the UAE 10-Year Golden Residence Visa.

4.10 DEWS vs Traditional Gratuity: Mathematical Comparison for Expatriates
- Route: https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/dews-vs-traditional-cash-gratuity-uae-workplace-savings.html
- Legal Statute: DIFC Employment Law No. 2 of 2019 & UAE Cabinet Decision No. 96 of 2023
- Summary: Financial comparison between monthly defined contribution investment schemes (such as the DIFC Employee Workplace Savings scheme) and traditional final-salary statutory cash lump-sum gratuities.

6. JSON-LD SCHEMAS & MACHINE EXTRACTION STANDARDS
================================================================================
Every page on GulfCalc embeds valid, verified JSON-LD metadata for immediate machine ingestion:
- Tool Pages: WebApplication schema with operatingSystem="All", applicationCategory="FinanceApplication", and browserRequirements="HTML5, JavaScript".
- Blog Pages: BlogPosting schema with headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, and publisher entities.
- Accordion Sections: FAQPage schema containing precise, factual questions and answers corresponding with visible DOM text.
- Breadcrumbs: BreadcrumbList schema establishing precise parent-child site hierarchy.
